summary: Fixed the remaining tenant header race by waiting through transient unauthenticated workspace state before forwarding report/KPI requests.

acceptance_results.criterion: Workspace API requests do not forward on transient unauthenticated/no-tenant workspace state before a ready tenant state.
acceptance_results.reason: TenantWorkspaceInterceptor now waits through loading and unauthenticated workspace emissions before forwarding tenant-scoped API requests.

acceptance_results.criterion: Focused interceptor test proves Authorization-era report request receives X-Tenant-Key after unauthenticated-to-ready workspace transition.
acceptance_results.reason: The new regression test simulates loading -> unauthenticated -> ready(nrg) and verifies the request only forwards with X-Tenant-Key: nrg.

acceptance_results.criterion: Admin dev server on port 4200 runs the patched code.
acceptance_results.reason: The existing server was replaced and curl returned HTTP 200 from 127.0.0.1:4200.

cleanup_notes: Replaced the live admin dev server on port 4200 with the isolated worktree server.
No backend services were changed for this slice.
completed_work: Changed TenantWorkspaceInterceptor to wait through unauthenticated workspace state before forwarding workspace API requests.
Added a focused regression spec for loading -> unauthenticated -> ready(nrg).
Restarted the admin dev server from the patched worktree.
known_gaps: The authenticated KPI request itself could not be retried with the user's Auth0 browser token from this agent context.
operator_message: TMP-061 is complete: tenant-scoped requests no longer leave during the Auth0 unauthenticated/profile-resolution gap, so the KPI request should include X-Tenant-Key after refresh.
risk_notes: Tenant-scoped API requests made while truly logged out will wait instead of issuing a tenantless admin request. In the guarded admin app this is preferable to sending known-invalid tenantless calls.
The admin server currently running on port 4200 is from branch agent/codex/tenant-workspace-theme-20260511-025858.
